text:
maria-docs: I opened a PR to update the Calypso-13B model card with supported variants, clarified seq limits, and a short SDK v2 snippet: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/1199

alan-eng: Quick read  the q4 variant shows max_seq=4096 but bench on orion-lite validated 8192 when using `profile='high-memory'`. Recommend we list default 4096 and note profile-enabled up to 8192 (hardware dependent).

jen-devex: CI flagged a broken anchor from the card to the profiles doc (`#runtime-profiles` -> site has `#profiles`). link-checker failed.

ci-bot: link-checker: 1 failure — sources/docs/model-catalog/calypso-13b.md: anchor '#runtime-profiles' not found.

maria-docs: I'll fix the anchor and add a short paragraph: "Quant variants: default sequence limit 4096; request `profile='high-memory'` to opt into extended limits up to 8192 where supported." Also adding SDK example using `profile`.

alan-eng: Use the v2 param `profile` in the snippet. And add a one-line fallback note: if profile isn't available the router may fallback to a compatible variant or region (may increase latency).

jen-devex: Good. Also add an indicative benchmark footnote: "approx 36 tok/s @seq=2048 (orion, batch=1) for q4; ~17 tok/s @seq=8192 under high-memory" with a clear disclaimer.

maria-docs: Snippet updated to:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('RW_KEY'))
# q4 with profile request
resp = client.generate(model='calypso-13b-q4_k_m', input='Summarize...', profile='high-memory')
print(resp.text)
# swap to fp16 for lower latency: model='calypso-13b-fp16'
```

ci-bot: pr-check: doc-lint passed, link-checker passed.

jen-devex: tiny copy edit pushed. Approved from docs.

alan-eng: Approved.

maria-docs: Merged. I'll watch for any follow-ups in #support. Thanks! :shipit:
